question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in Discord subagent progress feature and its new configuration, hook metadata, lifecycle adapter, and persisted cleanup state after the concurrency defect is repaired?
rationale: Patch correctness cannot determine whether seven new configuration fields and a channel-specific progress lifecycle should become permanent bundled product and API surface.

options.title: Adopt after repair
options.body: Keep the current feature direction, require per-message serialization and exact-head live proof, then land after Discord and agent lifecycle owner review.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Retain visible Discord progress while reducing configuration options or avoiding additional persisted core lifecycle state.

options.title: Decline the bundled feature
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers do not want channel-specific subagent progress as a bundled OpenClaw capability.

recommendation.title: Adopt after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the current feature direction, require per-message serialization and exact-head live proof, then land after Discord and agent lifecycle owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work directly owns the Discord subagent hook loading and channel boundary surfaces that determine whether this lifecycle API shape fits.
